== Summary ==
Black-bordered errata card for [[Undercover (Decipher Errata 1998)]], made by swccg.com on 22 November 2026 from Decipher's white-bordered Revised card [[Undercover (Revised)]] (September 1998). The Revised card's game text is word for word Decipher's errata for this card (checked by eye against the Glossary entry), so its black-bordered form is the playable card with Decipher's words (Bill's ruling of 22 November 2026, swccg-guild/work #1297, spec v10).

How it was made, with [https://github.com/billbisco/ai-team-skills/blob/main/shared/swccg-wiki/evidence/pc-errata-versions/handoff-1297/tools/revised_to_black.py revised_to_black.py]: the drop shadow was cropped off along the card's black outline (367×506 → 350×490, crop box 3,3,353,493), the white border was turned black and the corners outside the rounded outline grey. Nothing else was changed: the text box, the picture and the Revised legal line are as printed.

Source scan: [[:File:ANH-R-L-undercoverwb.gif]] (SHA-1 <code>f3281791555a795e63411f0458abe3bf61dce9b3</code>). This file: SHA-1 <code>3b0a99e8aa23c7d3f9077cc62c01d185d8f0e995</code>.
